name: AVID Racing (UTV)
old_description: Precision-machined titanium hardware, designed in-house for maximum strength-to-weight, precise fitment, and ultimate corrosion resistance.
about:
AVID Racing operates from Fresno, California, where it designs, engineers, and manufactures its UTV suspension systems and titanium hardware under one roof. The company emphasizes that all engineering, manufacturing, and support functions are housed in its Fresno facility, though a founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company produces platform-specific suspension kits, titanium hardware replacement packages, shocks, and builder components for side-by-side vehicles. Its product line includes complete front and rear long-travel kits, control arms, trailing arms, and hundreds of titanium bolt kits tailored to models such as the Can-Am Maverick R, Polaris RZR Pro R, and Yamaha YXZ1000. Materials used are 7075 aluminum, 4130 chromoly, and Ti-6Al-4V titanium alloy, selected per application. Manufacturing processes include precision machining, welding, and assembly, with fitment verified through an online Shock Center that matches specifications to vehicle configurations.

AVID serves the off-road powersports market, targeting UTV owners, racers, and fabricators who need direct-fit suspension upgrades and corrosion-resistant hardware. Concrete applications span Can-Am Maverick R and X3, Polaris RZR Pro R, and Yamaha YXZ1000 platforms, with kits ranging from 12-piece shock bolt sets to 170-piece ultimate suspension replacement packages.

The company differentiates itself through a geometry-first engineering approach that evaluates motion ratio, leverage curves, load paths, and steering behavior as an integrated system rather than maximizing travel alone. It promotes race-proven materials, in-house manufacturing control, and direct technical support without intermediaries.
